messages:
maria_marketing: Quick sync  We're targeting a public announcement for Optimize v1.3 next Tuesday 10:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical docs links, and confirmed canary timing so comms + webinar invite are locked.

noah_eng: On changelog now. Will post final bullets by EOD tomorrow. Are we doing staged rollout or single wave?

maria_marketing: Staged preferred: 5% canary for 2h, then 25% for 4h, then full after 24h. That reduces likelihood of demo disruptions.

noah_eng: Ok. We'll include an automatic fallback to the compact model variant in routing policy. Also adding rollback thresholds for SRE to act on.

priya_docs: I can prepare the release page and a short quantization guide. Need exact changelog lines and an anonymized rollout YAML snippet to paste into docs.

noah_eng: Draft changelog (WIP):
- Improved batching heuristics to reduce tail latency for short prompts
- Fix: prefix KV cache invalidation in multi-tenant pools
- Added q4_legacy quantization profile: ~20% memory reduction with minimal quality impact
- Canary routing with automatic fallback to compact model variant

maria_marketing: Great. Priya can you alias the docs as /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization so marketing links stay stable?

priya_docs: Yep. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT. I'll include an anonymized YAML example and a troubleshooting/rollback section covering 95th latency and error-rate checks.

sam_product: Add paragraph: q4_legacy recommended for low-latency chat & high-concurrency inference; include suggested eval prompts and a note on expected small quality delta.

lena_design: I'll make the hero image + social tiles. Copy constraint: no hard latency numbers.

maria_marketing: Correct  use relative language: "~20% memory reduction" and "15-25% fewer tail spikes in internal chat benchmarks." We'll cite bench deck.

noah_eng: Deployment plan: canary starts 10:00 PT. Health checks evaluate 95th percentile latency and error rate in 15m windows. Auto-rollback if 95th >15% vs baseline or error rate >0.5%. release-bot will post updates to #release-war-room.

release-bot: Scheduled canary: 1771002468 (10:00 PT). Will post pings at stage boundaries.

priya_docs: On the YAML question: should we surface autoscale numbers? Theyre customer-specific.

sam_product: Use placeholders for capacity values; show pattern only.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: tomorrow EOD  final changelog from eng. Tomorrow 12:00 PT  docs live. Monday AM  design assets. Tuesday 10:00 PT  announce + canary. Wed  webinar invite to opt-ins.

noah_eng: Confirmed. I'll post the final changelog with timestamps and include rollback thresholds for appendix.

priya_docs: Will post doc URLs here when live.

lena_design: Assets uploaded to marketing drive Monday AM; will drop links here.

maria_marketing: Thanks all. Flag blockers here ASAP. :thumbsup:

noah_eng: Small note  include customer opt-out instructions for pinned model versions in the appendix.

maria_marketing: We'll add opt-out instructions and the rollback appendix to the blog draft.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1771002812  pre-launch checklist ping to this channel."
